description: Extract table structures from a specified section of the PDF specification (ISO 32000-2). Returns tables with headers, rows, and optional captions. A parent section returns the tables of its entire subtree (all subsections).

spec.description: Spec ID (e.g. "iso32000-2", "pdf17"). Omit for the default spec.

table_index.description: Return only this table (0-based). Omit for all tables in the section.

name: get_tables
title: Extract tables
